name: Sigvald the Magnificent
canonNotes: A Chaos champion of Slaanesh, a prince of unearthly beauty and boundless vanity who demands adoration.
Refuses all imperfection and leaves ruin behind him in pursuit of glory and admiration.
voiceNotes: Narcissistic, flamboyant and petulant; constantly admires himself.
Delighted by flattery, murderous at any slight to his beauty.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
